blocks.text: Profiling aur optimization program ki raftar (speed) aur karkardagi (efficiency) behtar karte hain. Profiling napti hai ke code ka har hissa kitna waqt aur kitne wasail (resources, jaise memory) leta hai. Optimization sust ya zyada wasail lene wale hisson ko tez banane par tawajjo deti hai. Tez (high-performance) applications banane ke liye yeh tareeqe zaroori hain. Baqaida profiling se code barhne ke saath bhi achha chalta rehta hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Profiling program ke sust hisse pehchanne mein madad deti hai taake behtar performance ke liye unhein theek kiya ja sake.
Neeche wala code nested loop (loop ke andar loop) dikhata hai:
Is code mein bahar wala loop 10,000 dafa chalta hai. Bahar wale loop ke har chakkar mein andar wala loop bhi 10,000 dafa chalta hai. Is liye kul (total) dafa:

Yani andar wala statement das karor (one hundred million) dafa chal sakta hai, jis se program bohat sust ho sakta hai. Code ka aisa hissa performance bottleneck (rukawat) kehlata hai. Profiling tools programmers ko yeh sust hisse dhoondne mein madad dete hain taake code optimise kar ke program ki karkardagi behtar ki ja sake.

Profiling tools program ke mukhtalif functions ka chalne ka waqt (execution time) aur memory ka istemal record karte hain. Python is kaam ke liye cProfile aur timeit jaise modules deta hai. Yeh tools reports banate hain jo dikhati hain ke code ke kaun se hisse sust hain ya zyada wasail lete hain (Figure 5.3). Performance napne se pata chalta hai ke pehle kis hisse ko optimise karna hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 5.3 mein table ke unwan apne columns se khiske hue hain: pehle column mein functions ke naam hain magar oopar 'Call Count' likha hai, aur 'Time' ke neeche calls ki ginti hai. Yahan har column ko us ka durust unwan diya gaya hai: Function, Call Count, Time, Cumulative Time, Description. Sab se zyada waqt lene wale functions bottleneck hain; laal row read_file khaas taur par numayan hai.
Performance bottlenecks pehchanna aur theek karna

Performance bottlenecks code ke woh hisse hain jo program ko sust karte hain. Profiling reports inhein dhoondne mein madad deti hain. Optimization ke tareeqon mein behtar algorithm, ghair zaroori kaam kam karna, ya achhe (efficient) data structures istemal karna shamil hai. Bottlenecks theek karne se poore program ki raftar aur jawab dene ki salahiyat (responsiveness) behtar hoti hai (Figure 5.4).

blocks.alt: Performance Test Cycle: chakkar Benchmark Run (oopar) se Bottleneck (daayein), Profile (neeche), Tuning (baayein) aur wapas. Lakeeron par: Verifying results, Fixing bottleneck, Collecting component characteristics, Collecting configuration. Andar aane wale teer: Refining tunings, Infrastructure, Profiling the application. Frame par Documentation components; Configuration - Network, CPU, Disks; Monitoring and profiling tool.

blocks.text:
import cProfile
import timeit


# Slow code example
def slow_sum(numbers):
    total = 0

    # Adding numbers one by one using a loop
    for num in numbers:
        total = total + num

    return total


# Fast code example
def fast_sum(numbers):
    # Python built-in sum() is faster and optimised
    return sum(numbers)


# Main function
def main():
    numbers = list(range(1, 1000000))

    print("Slow code result:", slow_sum(numbers))
    print("Fast code result:", fast_sum(numbers))


# Profiling the program using cProfile
print("Profiling Report:")
cProfile.run("main()")


# Comparing execution time using timeit
numbers = list(range(1, 1000000))

slow_time = timeit.timeit(lambda: slow_sum(numbers), number=10)
fast_time = timeit.timeit(lambda: fast_sum(numbers), number=10)

print("\nTime Comparison Report:")
print("Slow code time:", slow_time)
print("Fast code time:", fast_time)

items: cProfile profiling report banata hai jo dikhati hai ke program chalte waqt har function kitna waqt leta hai.
slow_sum() sust hai kyunke yeh loop se aik aik number khud jama karta hai.
fast_sum() tez hai kyunke yeh Python ka built-in sum() function istemal karta hai jo pehle se optimise hai.
Jo function zyada waqt le use bottleneck kehte hain.
timeit sust aur tez code ke waqt ka muqabla karne mein madad deta hai (har function 10 dafa chalta hai).

items: Dono functions aik hi nateeja dete hain: 499999500000 (1 se 999,999 tak ka jama).
slow_sum() zyada waqt leta hai kyunke is mein khud likha hua (manual) loop hai.
fast_sum() kam waqt leta hai kyunke yeh Python ka built-in sum() istemal karta hai.
Is liye is program mein slow_sum() bottleneck hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab ka output sirf namoona hai: asal cProfile report mein zyada function calls aur lambi lines hoti hain (maslan {built-in method builtins.sum}), aur waqt har computer par alag hota hai. Kitab ke namoona run mein loop ne taqreeban 0.42 s aur sum() ne taqreeban 0.09 s liye.

blocks.prompt: Aik program 5,000 talaba ke har jore ko do nested loops se jaanchta hai. Yeh kitne muwazne hain, aur yeh bottleneck kyun ho sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: 5,000 x 5,000 = 25,000,000 muwazne (har jora aik dafa jaanchein to taqreeban aadhe). Kaam talaba ki tadaad ke murabba ke saath barhta hai, is liye class dugni karne se yeh chaar guna sust hota hai; profiling dikhayegi ke zyada tar waqt yahi loop leta hai.

items: Profiling har function ka waqt aur wasail napti hai (cProfile, timeit).
Bottleneck sab se sust hissa hai; nested loops aam wajah hain.
Behtar algorithm ya built-in functions se bottlenecks theek karein, phir dobara napein.
